g.text: Calendar-weighted fraction of days at DHW ≥4
Historical spawning-calendar weights held fixed across all 39 years

rect.style: stroke-width: 1.16; stroke: none; fill: #FFFFFF;

g.text: Sources: Coral Spawning Database v1; NOAA Coral Reef Watch. Monthly event shares are calculated per site, then sites receive equal weight within a region.
This is a fixed-calendar exposure index, not a measured change in spawning, a mortality estimate or a forecast. Observation effort can influence the historical calendar.
17 well-recorded sites connect biological calendars to 14 NOAA regions.
Historical spawning seasons show uneven heat-stress exposure
